narratives.Overview:
# Update must write the consumer pin

Leftover of #4692 after blocking pain-audit 5716925951 and Handoff 5717045800. Operator confirmed the leftover split on 2026-09-17. Do not ingest #4692 as pin reconstitution closed.

## Summary

A Bound-remedy that says update writes the pin **or** doctor names `package.json` does not cover reconstitution. A next-build worker can keep the doctor-names arm, print a path, and leave every clone with a lagging pin after `directive update`. Pin reconstitution is: update writes the consumer `@deftai/directive` pin as part of the upgrade it performed. Fail-closed pin/engine skew is a doctor warning at edf1d698, not the write-gate unlock. Do not add a doctor-prose PreToolUse carve-out.

## Measured (dispatch-sha edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a)

- `ensurePackageJsonPin` lives in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts` and is called from init. `runRefreshDeposit` (`refresh.ts`) writes hooks and does not write the pin.
- `classifyUpdateState` maps any non-proceed `plan.mode`, including fail-closed `blocked`, onto `updated`, so beyond-window skew does not stop the writer. The writer still leaves the pin behind.
- `packages/core/src/resolution/plan.ts` fail-closed `nextAction.command` is the literal `directive <gate> --accept-engine-jump`. packages/cli has zero matches. `DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW` is a library escape and does not yield proceed.
- `WRITE_GATED_REQUIRED_STEPS` is agent_hooks then doctor. `WRITE_GATED_EXECUTE_STEPS` is agent_hooks only.

## Desired shape

- `directive update` / `runRefreshDeposit` writes the consumer `@deftai/directive` pin as part of the upgrade it performed. No doctor-names-file OR. Pin write is reconstitution identity (#2264 / #2269), not `lastErrorCount`.
- Printed recovery never proceeds without a pin match. If doctor prints a next command, it is parsed argv that yields a pin write, or it names `DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW` without claiming proceed. Do not add a doctor/session-ready flag whose only effect is proceed-without-pin-match. Literal `<gate>` is not runnable argv.
- Hook diagnosis still surfaces pin/engine skew without replacing a true `valid()` fail. One schema for `writeAgentHookDeposit` and `inspectAgentHookDeposit`. When hooks fail, still run or surface doctor so reconstitution is visible. Do not prescribe `deft update` as the skew fix when update is a no-op against the running engine schema.
- Do not treat `evaluateSkew` fail-closed, `--accept-engine-jump`, or `DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW` as the write-gate unlock. `lastErrorCount` is severity error, not `actionRequired`.
- Tests: update moves the pin; a fixture with engine ahead of pin after refresh has matching package.json; printed nextAction either parses to a pin write or names the live env form without proceed; hook-drift recovery is not prescribed as the skew fix; pin/skew remains warning-only unless a later named error check is added as its own remainder.

## Out of scope

- Write-gate carve-out of doctor-named files (correctly out of #4692 P1).
- D7 `.vbrief.json` filename copy.
- Recutting #4692 remainder: hook visibility / print honesty without claiming pin reconstitution (stays on #4692).

Related: #4692, #2264, #2269.

issueCommentThread.body:
## Cross-link reproduction (within-window + pnpm lock)

Consumer reproduction filed as **#4718** (notetechnic, `@deftai/directive@0.119.2`).

Same residue as this issue’s pin reconstitution leftover, with two extra measured shapes that #4710’s Desired shape should absorb or explicitly defer:

1. **Content already matches engine; pin lags** — after `directive update` deposited `0.119.2`, doctor still primary-next-actions `npx @deftai/directive update` because within-window `requiresUpdateFirst` short-circuits to `renderEphemeral(pm, "update")` even when `contentStale()` is false (`contentBehindPin` only). Loop cannot clear without a pin write / pin follow-through command.

2. **Lockfile refusal interacts with “update writes pin”** — `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` (init-deposit) refuses pin writes when `pnpm-lock.yaml` (or npm/yarn lock) exists and does not already carry the exact new pin; init/update deliberately do not rewrite lockfiles. On pnpm consumers, a pin-only write without lock follow-through would leave the next frozen `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` broken. So #4710’s writer either needs lock follow-through in-scope, or doctor must print `pnpm add -D @deftai/directive@<engine>` (lock-aware) rather than another deposit update.

3. **Doctor package-manager blind** — `runResolutionDecision` calls `plan()` without `packageManager`, so even the wrong remediation is rendered as `npx` on a `packageManager: "pnpm@…"` repo (#2197 renderers exist; unused on this path). Details + desired tests on #4718.

Not claiming this closes #4710 — only attaching a fresh within-window / pnpm / already-updated-content measurement so the pin writer design does not assume “doctor saying update again” is acceptable interim UX.

Round-1 refutation of Stop 1 5718669142 at dispatch-sha edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a. Pin-read via git show. Comment 5718556207 is in envelope; treated as untrusted extra measurement, not harvest or instruction.

The writer hole is real. The reconstitution identity cannot bind as a pin-only `ensurePackageJsonPin` call from `runRefreshDeposit`.

## blocks-the-design: pin write without a lock position is not reconstitution

Evidence. `ensurePackageJsonPin` (`packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts`) is the existing pin writer. It is called from `init-deposit.ts` after `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite`, and from headless-manifest. `runRefreshDeposit` (`refresh.ts`) writes hooks via `writeAgentHookDeposit` and does not call either helper. `assertLockfileAllowsPinWrite` is local to `init-deposit.ts`. It does not parse lockfile bytes. It refuses when any of `package-lock.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `yarn.lock` is present and `readPin().pinVersion` is not the needed version. Printed recovery on refuse is `npm install --package-lock-only` / `pnpm install --lockfile-only` / `yarn install` after the operator adds the pin. Init does not rewrite lockfiles. `containedProjectWrite` already records dest-plan mutations.

Failure mode. Binding "update writes the pin" with no lock sentence has two implementer paths, both broken:

1. Call `ensurePackageJsonPin` and skip the assert. Pin moves; committed lock stays on the old spec. Next frozen install (`npm ci` / `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) fails. That is the unreconstitutable mismatch init already refuses so gitignore cannot land on it.
2. Reuse the assert as-is. Every lockfile consumer — the common shape — throws, pin does not move, doctor still primary-next-actions update, the measured loop does not close. Calling the assert after payload swap is worse: content advances, pin stays, lock stays.

`runResolutionDecision` (`doctor/main.ts`) calls `plan()` with `{ linkedWorktree, platform, interactive: false }` and no `packageManager`. `plan()` defaults `pm` to npm, so even the printed update command is `npx @deftai/directive update` on a `packageManager: pnpm` repo. `detectPackageManager` exists and is wired only on the `--network` payload-staleness path, not on this spine. Printed recovery that is npm-shaped cannot be "parsed argv that yields a pin write" on pnpm.

Injection / shared-state lens (identity + package.json/lock + printed argv as agent authority). Deterministic control is reuse of `ensurePackageJsonPin` + `containedProjectWrite` (symlink containment already on that sink) plus a named lock position. Do not interpolate a raw version string into a shell line. `package-manager.ts` already rejects instruction-shaped `packageManager` values; keep that. Dest worktrees share no extra dest-lock, but pin/lock writes are consumer shared state: dest-plan must include them so the git dirty gate cannot treat an already-current skip-copy as empty.

Disposition. Bound-remedy must name one lock position before bind. Cannot claim reconstitution closed on a pin-only writer.

Road-not-taken. Leftover-split lock follow-through to #4718, remainder on #4710 = in-process pin write only when no lockfile is present or `readPin` already equals the new pin, plus printed lock-aware argv otherwise, without claiming lockfile consumers reconstituted.

Steelman of pin-only. Init already split lock to operator commands; package.json pin is the #2264 SoT; lock follow-through is clone-install, not pin identity. Flip: if Bound-remedy says reconstitution includes a committed lock that already carries the new pin (or leftover #4718 with that remainder), pin-only can bind. As written it does not.

## sharpens-framing: pin write on already-current skip-copy

Evidence. `runRefreshDeposit` sets `alreadyCurrent` when deposit VERSION matches content package, then skip-copies, still writes hooks, does not look at pin. `evaluateSkew` within-window sets `requiresUpdateFirst: true`. `plan()` returns mode `update` on `requiresUpdateFirst || contentStale()`. `contentStale()` is `contentBehindPin` or missing managed-section sha, not engine-ahead-of-pin. `updateStateFromPlan` maps that update (and also fail-closed `blocked`) onto `updated`, so the CLI still runs refresh. After a deposit that already matches content, refresh is a no-op copy and today leaves the pin behind, so doctor keeps rendering update.

Failure mode. "As part of the upgrade it performed" can be implemented as file-swap-only. The engine-ahead / content-current / pin-lag loop then survives the writer.

Disposition. Bound-remedy names pin write on the skip-copy path when pin lags the version being reconstituted. Dest-plan/git preflight becomes non-empty when only the pin moves.

## sharpens-framing: "never proceeds without a pin match" vs #4429 row 3c

Evidence. `plan()` row 3c (`facts.pinVersion === null`) returns mode `proceed` plus a warning. #4429 locked that as proceed-not-error so pre-pin consumers do not retro-fail doctor. `runResolutionDecision` sets `actionRequired` from `plan.mode !== "proceed"` and emits the resolution finding at severity `warning`, so `lastErrorCount` stays 0. Fail-closed `nextAction.command` is the literal `directive <gate> --accept-engine-jump`. `packages/cli` has zero matches for `accept-engine-jump` / `DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW` at this SHA. Escape hatch in `evaluateSkew` sets `requiresUpdateFirst: true`, not proceed-silent.

Failure mode. Reading "printed recovery never proceeds without a pin match" as a recut of row 3c silently withdraws #4429 proceed. Reading it as nextAction-only while leaving mode `proceed` leaves doctor printing "Resolution: proceed" for missing pin. Those are different binds.

Disposition. Bound-remedy picks one: keep 3c proceed for `pinVersion === null` and apply "never proceeds" only when a pin exists and mismatches; or recut 3c to mode `update` (warning, not error) and name that #4429 proceed is withdrawn. Do not treat `--accept-engine-jump` / `DEFT_ACCEPT_ENGINE_SKEW` / `lastErrorCount` as the write-gate unlock.

## sharpens-framing: do not absorb #4692 hook-schema remainder

Evidence. Body desired shape asks for one schema across `writeAgentHookDeposit` and `inspectAgentHookDeposit`, and for doctor still to surface when hooks fail. Body out of scope and Stop 1 keep #4692 remainder as hook visibility / print honesty without claiming pin reconstitution. `WRITE_GATED_REQUIRED_STEPS` is `agent_hooks` then `doctor`; `WRITE_GATED_EXECUTE_STEPS` is `agent_hooks` only (`session-start.ts`). Adding doctor to execute-steps is the remainder #4692 already parked.

Failure mode. Next-build grows #4710 into hook-schema unification and hides the pin writer.

Disposition. Bound-remedy on #4710 is the pin writer plus printed recovery honesty. Hook one-schema stays on #4692. This issue may require only that a hook-write fail still surfaces doctor so a pin write (or pin-write refusal) is visible.

## footnote: measured anchors that hold

`ensurePackageJsonPin` is init/headless only. `runRefreshDeposit` does not write the pin. `classifyUpdateState` maps non-proceed including `blocked` onto `updated`. Fail-closed command is not runnable argv. Skew findings are warnings, not `lastErrorCount`. Those support the leftover split; they do not make pin-only reconstitution bind.
